about_short_description.short_description: Mercoa is a bill pay and accounts payable API for B2B fintech.

product.name: Accounts Payable (AP)
product.description: An API-driven solution to process bills via email or manual upload, manage vendors, track payments, and automate approval workflows.

product.name: Accounts Receivable (AR)
product.description: An API and component-based solution to automate invoicing, send branded invoices, and manage payment collection with AI-driven reminders.

product.name: MAi – AI-Powered Embedded Invoicing Agent
product.description: An AI agent that extracts payment terms from contracts emailed to it and automatically generates invoices and follow-ups.

product.name: Embedded BillPay API
product.description: An API and component suite enabling businesses to embed accounts payable payment methods and workflows into their platforms.

product.name: Embedded Invoicing API
product.description: An API and component-based solution for businesses to onboard customers, accept payments, and automate collections with multiple payment options.
